# dodopayments_addons (Data Source)

Lists addons.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dodopayments_addons" "example" {
  max_items = 10
}

output "addons" {
  value = data.dodopayments_addons.example.items
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) List archived addons. The default is false.
- `locale` (String) Shows the translated name, description and unit of the catalog entities in this
locale. The value must be a code from `GET /locales`, for example `fr`.
A field with no translation, an unknown code, or no code shows the base text.

Do not send a text from a localized response back in a create or update request.
The base text then changes to the translated text.
- `max_items` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. The default is 1000.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The addons that the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `business_id` (String) Unique identifier for the business to which the addon belongs.
- `created_at` (String) Created time.
- `currency` (String) Currency of the Addon.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the Addon.
- `id` (String) id of the Addon.
- `image` (String) Image of the Addon.
- `name` (String) Name of the Addon.
- `price` (Number) Amount of the addon.
- `tax_category` (String) Tax category applied to this Addon.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated time.
